# Team

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("Team")`

A side (ADR 0099): a name -- its `Name` -- a colour, and the players whose `Player.Team` is it. It counts only under `TeamService`, which is what carries it to every replica.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AutoAssign` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether a player who joins may be put on this team. The engine picks the `AutoAssign` team with the fewest players. |
| `Color` | `Color3` | `Color3.new(1, 1, 1)` | read/write | The side's colour, for a game to paint name tags, scoreboards and shirts with. |

## Methods

### `GetPlayers(): { Player }`

Every player on this team, in the order they joined.
